message:
Yen receipts now show correctly: `Paid ¥500 by card`. The yen receipt test passes, and so do all 18 tests in `npm test`.

The bug was in `formatMoney` in `src/utils/money.js`. It divided every amount by 100, so 500 yen came out as `¥5.00`. I added a small set of currencies with no minor unit (just `JPY for now`) and print those amounts as they are.

`formatMoney` is shared by invoices, payments, cart and admin, so yen amounts in all of those will now format the same way. Their tests still pass.
